title: SourceOutput
description: `source` role output (§13). Changed sentences are computed by the server (sentence diff), not by the model.

notes.description: Full rewritten source notes; reversals resolved. Server rejects an empty result when previous notes were non-empty.

questions.description: Follow-up questions for missing or ambiguous information.

similar_names.description: Pairs of names that may be one entity spelled differently (레오/래오), within the notes or against existing cards.

card_id.description: Existing card named similar_to, or null if it is only in the notes.
